description: OpenWasteWater supplies OpenModelica wastewater models developed for teaching at Hamburg University of Technology, adapting concepts from the earlier WasteWater library. This resource is provided by jobehrendt (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC0-1.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The README discusses compatibility and documentation problems in other libraries; it does not establish compatibility with every Modelica environment. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
